description: Search the ITIS (Integrated Taxonomic Information System) database by scientific name or partial name. Returns matching taxa with their TSN (Taxonomic Serial Number), full scientific name, author citation, and kingdom — the TSN can then be used with itistaxonomy.get_full_record for full classification detail (itis.gov, USGS public data)

query.description: Scientific name or partial name to search (e.g. "Puma concolor", "Bison bison", or genus only "Ursus").

name: science.itistaxonomy.search_scientific

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Taxa by Scientific Name
